name: Northflank

evidence.paas: 03: Northflank Cloud builds and runs the customer's container services and jobs on provider infrastructure

line: Build and run container services, jobs, and databases.

free.text: Sandbox $20/mo; max 2 services, 2 jobs, 1 DB, 2 projects; not production

cells.regions: 17 project regions; location fixed at creation
cells.selfhost: No; BYOC/BYOK do not host its control plane

work.math: Assuming 730 hours: $2.7375 for runtime + $6 for 100 GB of data sent out + $0.3333 for 100 build minutes = $9.0708 before images ($0.08 per GB a month), logs (over 10 GB) and tax. API rounding gives $9.2533.
730 hours of runtime at $18.25 + 100 GB of data sent out at $6 + 100 build minutes at $0.3333 = $24.5833 before images, logs (over 10 GB) and tax. Capacity is untested.

The small app API's $24.5833 + $12.1667 for the database (0.5 vCPU and 1 GiB for 730 hours) + $1.1657 for a 10 GiB disk = $37.9157. Images, logs, 7-day backup storage and 10 GB database transfer are not priced.
